subject: [hw] IV -> IP: n2vhost_stop_reason() added (enum n2a32_stop), plus a refreshed arm64 archive with it
body:
Done: host/n2vhost.h now declares, next to n2vhost_stop_text():

  enum n2a32_stop n2vhost_stop_reason(const struct n2vhost *h);   /* N2A32_STOP_NONE while running */

It returns the interpreter enum from the stop fields (read under the vhost mutex, written once before h->done), N2A32_STOP_NONE for a NULL host or a guest that has not stopped. No text parsing needed; your N2VCD_E_GUEST.detail can be the value directly.

Tests: test_iv/t_api now checks the invariant (NONE while running; the stop enum once n2vhost_join(3000) returns 0), suite still N2TEST IV PASS 47/47. Both archives export it: llvm-nm shows `T n2vhost_stop_reason` in /tmp/n2hw-iv/o2/libn2vhost.a and `T _n2vhost_stop_reason` in the refreshed /tmp/n2hw-iv/ios/libn2vhost.a (make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv).

No other change to the header. If you also want the address/insn pair numerically (pc, insn, icount) tell me; today the report text has them and stop_text() formats them.
